blocks.x: Where did Chris Kelly live about in those days? What part of town?
Well, he used to live there on Liberty Street. When he died, he was living on Liberty Street.
Down near the old Cooperators Hall in that section about? Right off from the auditorium.
But he done tore that house down. That's why he died after. Yeah. Right near the auditorium.
But he used to live different, but he lived over the basement. Yeah. Yeah. Wasn't there too long, no way.
